 Meteorologist Hunter Clouser’s Sunday Evening Forecast: November 1st, 2026! 
 Meteorologist Hunter Clouser has your forecast! By Hunter Clouser Published : Nov. 1, 2026 at 6:45 PM EST | Updated : 8 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google Lima, OH (WLIO) - Well, more clouds and mild temperatures today, and tomorrow appears to be a repeat. Some sunshine appears possible with a very unseasonably warm Tuesday, but rain chances climb during the midweek, with showery activity expected on Wednesday, especially. Still, a (relatively) warm week ahead!
